issue.title: Task-bead backlog, epic 1: fix the five most important open task beads
issue.description: The five most important open task beads in the sase project are resolved on master and closed with recorded evidence: sase-1of (Full CI visual-test red), sase-14r (the shard-timings table is about to turn Master Gate red), sase-1nw (the stuck bead read model burns CPU and disk on athena), sase-yo (closed-as-done beads strand unlanded work), and sase-1dp (agent transcripts reach the public sidecar unscanned). The land agent then starts the next backlog epic, five beads at a time, until no workable task bead remains.

payload.entry:
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: lander owns a /sase_gate for an athena reinstall of sase once master contains this core fix and the sase-core-revision.txt pin. Do not reinstall globally or publish that gate before the host has landed the pin. global-install-is-human-only applies.

Fix/test evidence (local, not live): crate-version mismatch recovery is in sase-core store.rs/tail.rs plus tests_version.rs. just test -p sase_core bead::read_model: 34 passed, including 10 version-convergence tests (snapshot/indexed/mutation recovery; later hits with aged sweep and 0 table rewrites; invalidation-fault still publishes crate_version; stale rebuild vs invalidation is Fault::Cache with 0 table rewrites; stale rebuild vs winner does not overwrite; racing readers converge; held connection stays readable). sase-core sase tool run check c1bca66c2532bfc38d091a7ce3eab98d succeeded. sase sase tool run check ac24f5f87321c4dbe40e3fa23d7cc5c0 succeeded.

Acceptance procedure for the gate:
1. Confirm the installed core includes the fix and identify any parked runners still using an older loaded extension.
2. Read cache metadata with a normal read-only SQLite connection (WAL-aware, not immutable=1), trigger the first normal bead read, and verify the stored crate_version and replay parity become current.
3. Observe later reads and an existing parked runner across at least two 60s fallback intervals. Confirm rebuild/content generations stay stable without store changes and the reported full-cache WAL churn is gone; ordinary telemetry writes are not failures.

Record the gate identity when settling sase-1nw. Leave sase-1nw open until that live acceptance is done.

Reproduced a crate_version=0.40.0 cache in sase-core tests: snapshot, indexed, and mutation-admission reads rebuilt forever via token fast-path after failed in-place invalidation, and CasLost open_and_serve treated invalidated leftover rows as a Hit. Fix: rebuild() cold-rebuilds on version mismatch; write_snapshot_in_txn CAS-checks generation before table rewrites and persists schema/reducer/crate versions with the snapshot; open_and_serve probes freshness so a CAS loser serves a winner only when it is still fresh. just test -p sase_core bead::read_model: 34 passed (10 new tests_version cases). sase-core check c1bca66c2532bfc38d091a7ce3eab98d succeeded. sase check ac24f5f87321c4dbe40e3fa23d7cc5c0 succeeded. Host must push linked sase-core then write sase-core-revision.txt. Live athena reinstall is a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP on this phase for the lander /sase_gate after master contains the pin; sase-1nw stays open until that acceptance.
